We have clarified that the release takes effect upon receipt of cleared funds and added customary confidentiality exceptions. Please provide your proposed payment terms and identify any additional release terms you seek.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full settlement payment in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from the claims at issue in this dispute. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We cannot accept the proposed USD 250,000 payment. The amount remains open, and no settlement is agreed. Subject to client approval and agreement on price, the revised draft incorporates payment within ten business days after execution, statutory interest on overdue sums, reasonable enforcement costs following default, and the proposed reciprocal-release structure. edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] within ten business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Any overdue amount shall bear interest from its due date until paid at the applicable statutory rate, to the extent permitted by law. Following a payment default, Plaintiff may recover reasonable costs incurred in enforcing Defendant's payment obligations, including reasonable attorneys' fees, to the extent permitted by law. The payment amount must be agreed and inserted before execution. This draft remains subject to client approval and is not a binding settlement offer or agreement.
edits.name: Payment and default remedies

edits.text: 2. RELEASES. Effective upon execution of this Agreement by both parties, Defendant releases Plaintiff from the claims at issue in this dispute. Upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full settlement payment in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from the claims at issue in this dispute. Neither release extends to obligations under this Agreement or claims to enforce it.
edits.name: Reciprocal releases
